candidates.term: The Rival inside the Legacy Gate
candidates.defline: Inside your Legacy Gate sits the shared harvest: what you build late in life is built with others.
candidates.reading: This position rules Family and Wealth. Your harvest wants company: children, proteges, partners who hold a piece of what you made. Handled well, this is the warmest ending a chart can write, a table of people invested in each other. Handled loosely, it is an estate dispute. Decide early what is shared and what is sealed, and say it out loud while everyone still laughs easily. Generosity plans best before it is needed.
